headline: On last trading day, Sensex and Nifty rallied to eight-month highs as markets remain closed today for Diwali-Balipratipada

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 11 November.

why: The Indian stock market is closed today, 10 November 2026, in observance of Diwali-Balipratipada.
Both the National Stock Exchange (NSE) and Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) have suspended trading for the holiday.
Trading activity is scheduled to resume during normal hours on Wednesday, 11 November 2026.
The closure affects all market segments including equity, derivatives, and the SLB segment.
whatHappening: In the last trading session, the Sensex and Nifty extended gains to close at their highest levels in over eight months.
Blackstone is set to become a key investor in IIFL Finance by acquiring a 15% stake in the company.
Global markets are monitoring Nvidia following a $1.57 trillion valuation wipeout, which exceeds Tesla's total market value.
Geopolitical tensions are reportedly easing as statements suggest the conflict with Iran is effectively over.
summary: Indian markets are closed today for Diwali-Balipratipada following a strong session where indices reached eight-month highs. Corporate activity is highlighted by Blackstone's move to acquire a 15% stake in IIFL Finance. Globally, investors are tracking significant volatility in US tech stocks and shifting geopolitical dynamics in the Middle East.
